name: io.github.spiceman161/keenetic-noc-mcp
description: Diagnose and safely manage Keenetic and Netcraze routers over remote HTTPS or LAN RCI.

environmentVariables.name: KEENETIC_HOST
environmentVariables.description: LAN router address. Use the profile wizard or set this with KEENETIC_USER and KEENETIC_PASSWORD_FILE.

environmentVariables.name: KEENETIC_USER
environmentVariables.description: Router login. Optional, defaults to admin.

environmentVariables.name: KEENETIC_PASSWORD_FILE
environmentVariables.description: Path to a file containing the router password. Preferred for non-interactive deployments.

environmentVariables.name: KEENETIC_URL
environmentVariables.description: Remote HTTPS RCI endpoint, ending in /rci/. Mutually exclusive with KEENETIC_HOST.
